{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the unique values in revenue and status
print("Unique values in status:", df['status'].unique())
print("Unique values in revenue:", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Show first 10

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {internal_test_mask.sum()}")

# Check sample of revenue strings for formatting
print("Sample of revenue strings:", df['revenue'].sample(5).values)"}
